mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, m.name AS name, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.case_type IN ('NOTICE', '공지', '공지사항') ORDER BY p.post_id DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CASE WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONSULT WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)
